In this month we gathered mostly around one event. Eighty-three of us said "state of the union" on 2026-02-24, and seventy-seven of us said "state of the union address" the same day. Forty-nine of us narrowed it to "trump's state of the union," forty-four to "trump's state of the union address," and thirty-four to "president trump's state of the union." First on this record, back in 2013, was John Barrasso.

Earlier, on 2026-02-11, thirty-seven of us said "save america act" and thirty-five said "the save america act," first from Chip Roy on 2026-01-29. Twenty-nine of us said "in federal elections" that same day.

So the record shows two convergences: a legislative one on the eleventh, an address on the twenty-fourth. We repeated these together, and we report them as we said them.
